title: Eridu found in the 1800s, its ziggurat never excavated

tellings.quote: so in the 1800s they find aido and they only excavate the main part of the city they find tablets and everything they bring them to the British museum they never excavate the arido zigon

plain: Eridu, an ancient city in southern Iraq, was found in the 1800s, but diggers only excavated the main city, took its clay tablets to the British Museum, and never dug into its ziggurat, the great stepped temple tower. The researcher Matt LaCroix tells this as a summary, with an encyclopedia entry on Eridu credited behind it. He raises it because he thinks something important may still lie inside the unexcavated tower.
